local DATUM = wf.vars.json.IDOC.ZCDF_HEAD.DATUM
local TIME = wf.vars.json.IDOC.ZCDF_HEAD.TIME
local function safe_sub(str, start, finish)
  local s = string.sub(str, start, math.min(finish, #str))
  return s ~= "" and s or "00"
end
local year   = safe_sub(DATUM, 1, 4)
local month  = safe_sub(DATUM, 5, 6)
local day    = safe_sub(DATUM, 7, 8)
local hour   = safe_sub(TIME, 1, 2)
local minute = safe_sub(TIME, 3, 4)
local second = safe_sub(TIME, 5, 6)
local iso_date = string.format('%s-%s-%sT%s:%s:%s.00000Z', year, month, day, hour, minute, second)
return iso_date

local function ensureArray(t)
  if type(t) ~= "table" then return {t} end
  local isArray = true
  for k, _ in pairs(t) do
    if type(k) ~= "number" or math.floor(k) ~= k then
      isArray = false
      break
    end
  end
  return isArray and t or {t}
end
local function ensureAllItemsAreArrays(objectsArray)
  if type(objectsArray) ~= "table" then return objectsArray end
  for _, obj in ipairs(objectsArray) do
    if type(obj) == "table" and obj.items then
      obj.items = ensureArray(obj.items)
    end
  end
  return objectsArray
end

local days_in_month = {31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31}
if not iso_time or not iso_time:match("^%d%d%d%d%-%d%d%-%d%dT") then return nil end
local function is_leap_year(y) return (y%4==0 and y%100~=0) or (y%400==0) end
local function days_since_epoch(y,m,d)
  local days=0
  for yr=1970,y-1 do days=days+(is_leap_year(yr) and 366 or 365) end
  for mo=1,m-1 do days=days+days_in_month[mo] if mo==2 and is_leap_year(y) then days=days+1 end end
  return days+(d-1)
end
local y,m,d,h,mi,s,sign,oh,om=iso_time:match("(%d+)-(%d+)-(%d+)T(%d+):(%d+):(%d+)([+-])(%d+):(%d+)")
if not y then return nil end
local total=days_since_epoch(tonumber(y),tonumber(m),tonumber(d))*86400+tonumber(h)*3600+tonumber(mi)*60+tonumber(s)
local off=tonumber(oh)*3600+tonumber(om)*60
return total-(sign=="+" and off or -off)
